GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 6-7l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # never a threat

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout. Approaching the 1200m, when the tempo slackened, had to be shifted out after becoming awkwardly placed near heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. hooked Wide in Straight . ran on well # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , overraced 2nd last Two Wide 11 Lengths 800m, still long way back getting Wide from the corner, Made Some Ground but was never close enough # made late ground
Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , Settled back 2nd last rails 5 Lengths 800m, off fence Straightening Up , did battle on well between runners but never close enough # battled on well
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 7 lengths. moved up very Wide turn. battled away. # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled Worse than midfield rails 6 Lengths 700m, stayed back inside but was only one paced in Straight # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 600m was obliged to be steadied and became held  up until passing the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Niggled to recover & raced keenly Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead) early . Stayed same until improving 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed to quicken Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & chased soundly until raced tight in last 75m. # Margin unfair.
Bit Slow Out 1 length settled back 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well making good ground without threatening # too far back
